import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import compiler
for name in ('hardfail', 'hard32'):
    d = json.load(open('tmp/%s.json' % name))
    links = [tuple(x) for x in d['links']]
    env = {int(k): v for k, v in d['env'].items()}
    parts = {int(k): v for k, v in d['parts'].items()}
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        plan = compiler.compile_plan(links, env, d['period'], parts, deadline=time.time()+25)
        ok = compiler.verify_plan(links, env, d['period'], parts, plan)
        print('%s verify=%s time=%.1fs' % (name, ok, time.time()-t0))
    except Exception as e:
        print('%s FAIL %.1fs' % (name, time.time()-t0))
EOF
